title: kate-core: build fold regions from syntax events
summary: regions_from_events pairs FoldEvent begin and end marks into FoldRegion values. Each region starts unfolded. Indent folds stay as they are. The test goes in the existing fold tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: fold.rs is a private module of view.rs. It has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add FoldRegion and regions_from_events. Keep both public inside this private module. Add #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))] on each, the same way indent_folds has it. A Begin pushes the line and the FoldId. An End pops the latest matching FoldId. When the end line is greater than that start line, push one FoldRegion with folded false. An end with no matching begin continues. A begin that never ends is dropped. Use let Some(index) = open.iter().rposition(...) else { continue }. Do not nest an if inside an if.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch indent_folds, line_indent, innermost_fold, or span_contains_line. Do not edit view.rs. The existing test a_no_break_space_line_stays_inside_the_fold stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test syntax_events_make_fold_regions uses FoldId 1 beginning on line 0, FoldId 2 beginning on line 1, FoldId 2 ending on line 3, FoldId 1 ending on line 4, and FoldId 9 ending on line 5. The regions are FoldRegion { start: 1, end: 3, folded: false } then FoldRegion { start: 0, end: 4, folded: false }. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: view::fold::tests::syntax_events_make_fold_regions
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because regions_from_events does not exist. After the change a nested begin and end pair makes two unfolded regions. An end with no begin adds nothing.
